value.rationale: A natural outer-parallel interpolation between the simplex extremizer and a circular body has a completely determined sharp two-segment Bezout profile, with radius-independent extremizing orientations but a surprising unique nonmonotone overshoot above the limiting disk value. This provides a structural obstruction to assuming monotonicity under rounding; the quantitative peak is slight but the exact phenomenon, uniqueness, and global directional inequality are nontrivial and geometrically motivated.
